name: Urban Forestry Challenge Fund
summary: Grants of GBP 2,000 to 100,000 for urban tree planting, urban woodland creation and greening projects in Scotland, run by community groups, charities and local authorities. The next round is expected in early 2027.

steps: Online form, completed in one sitting

eligibility.rule: Applicant is a registered or constituted not-for-profit body
Project has a strong focus on urban Scotland
Project runs for no more than three years

documents: Organisation constitution or articles of association, unless a Local Authority

applicant_types.quote: Community groups and development trusts State-funded schools and education providers Local authorities Registered charities and community interest companies

geography.quote: Projects must focus on urban areas in Scotland

access.quote: Step 3: Submit your application Ready to go? Please note the online form must be completed in one sitting

amount.quote: Small projects: £2,000 to £20,000 for local tree planting or green space improvements Larger projects: £20,000 to £100,000 for more ambitious urban forestry or woodland projects

co_finance_required.quote: Projects seeking over £20,000 will be expected to secure match funding.

effort.quote: Step 3: Submit your application Ready to go? Please note the online form must be completed in one sitting
Larger grants (£20,000-£100,000): This is a two-stage process.

eligibility.quote: any not-for-profit registered or constituted body
All projects must have a strong focus on urban Scotland
Projects can run for up to three years.

documents.quote: Please upload your organisation's constitution or articles of association (if you are applying on behalf of a Local Authority, we do not require this):
a copy of your organisation's most recent accounts project budget details of any partnership arrangement.

Please upload a map, if applicable, and any other supporting documentation, such as annual report, images, partnership agreements or letters of support, up to a maximum of three files in this section.
